title: Asphalt Calculator
benefit: Tons of Hot Mix for a Driveway
cardBlurb: Tons and cubic yards of hot-mix asphalt
seoTitle: Asphalt Calculator - Tons for a Driveway
metaDescription: Convert a driveway or path size and compacted thickness into tons and cubic yards of hot-mix asphalt, using the 110 lb per sq yd per inch rate state DOTs use.
secondaryKeywords: how many tons of asphalt do i need
tons of asphalt per square yard
intent: Convert a driveway or path area and compacted thickness into tons and cubic yards of hot-mix asphalt.
registerRow: Not on the Oct 2026 Keyword Register: category-fill addition (Driveways and Paths) chosen by the redesign brief; hot-mix asphalt tons, not crushed stone (Gravel).
intro: Enter a driveway or path size and the compacted thickness to get tons of hot-mix asphalt to order, using the 110 lb per square yard per inch rate in state DOT specifications.
chartTitle: Tons for this area at 1 to 4 in compacted thickness (with your allowance)
diagramCaption: Driveway with its compacted thickness (and layers). It redraws as you type.
uniqueAddition: Tonnage from the spread rate state DOTs write into their hot-mix specifications (110 lb per sq yd per inch, TxDOT, VDOT, INDOT), editable for your plant's mix, with optional base and surface layers and a table of common driveway sizes at 2 and 3 in.

inputs.name: thickness
inputs.label: Compacted thickness
inputs.help: After rolling, 0.5 to 12 in. With two layers, this is the base layer.

inputs.name: rate
inputs.label: Spread rate
inputs.help: 90 to 130. 110 is the planning rate in TxDOT and VDOT specifications (about 146.7 lb per cu ft). Use your plant's figure if it gives one.

inputs.name: waste
inputs.label: Extra allowance
inputs.help: 0 to 20%. Extra for uneven base and edges. 5% is our estimate, not a published figure.

sources.title: Item 341, Dense-Graded Hot-Mix Asphalt, 2014 Standard Specifications (Texas Department of Transportation): thickness based on 110 lb per sq yd for each inch of pavement
Instructional and Informational Memorandum IIM-LD-158 (Virginia Department of Transportation, Location and Design Division): application rate based on 110 lb per sq yd per inch of thickness
Hot Mix Asphalt Paving, 2025 (Indiana Department of Transportation): 110 lb per sq yd is about 1 in of compacted depth; some aggregates weigh more or less
